content:
kim (CEO): Short exec weekly: main asks for the week — EU Private beta limited launch next week, finalize default retention policy, and get p95 for Dedicated EU under our SLA. Need concise slide bullets for the Board by Fri.

marta_vp_eng: On EU beta: feature set locked for the cohort. We're prioritizing stability fixes only. Will run end-to-end SLA tests tonight.

samir_vp_ops: Ops update: cert rotation in eu-west-1 completes today. Scheduling a small retention canary (0.5% traffic). Will monitor KV cache miss and disk ops.

michael_fin: Finance target: -7% per-token cost QoQ. Quick levers: quantize non-customer-facing models, tighten reserved pooling, and optimize default batching. I'll put a short heatmap in the Board deck.

nina_legal: Policy proposal: default log retention for Private = 30 days, with a contractual opt-in for longer retention. Legal + Security approve. Need Ops to confirm rollout flags and Sales to prepare exception language.

ops-bot: System: "Retention rollout scheduled: retention.default_days_private=30; canary=2026-06-10..2026-06-11; canary_sample=0.5%" React with :eyes: when reviewed.

marta_vp_eng: SLA note: if p95 regresses >1.5% during canary, pause and escalate. I'll post the p95/p99 matrix to #eng-status after tests.

samir_vp_ops: Adding alerts: retention.apply_failures >0.1% and kv_cache_miss_ratio delta >3% over 5m.

michael_fin: Also tracking revenue signal: Dedicated adoption target +10% ARR this year. Will sync with Sales to align incentives.

kim (CEO): Owners and asks for Board slide pack:
- Marta: one slide on SLA readiness + test matrix (due Thu noon)
- Samir: canary rollout plan + incident mitigations (due Thu EOD)
- Michael: cost lever heatmap + revenue note (due Thu EOD)
- Nina: two-line retention rationale and customer exception flow (due Fri 10:00 PT)

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Board slide deadline" Thu 17:00 PT.

kim (CEO): Keep messages short in the deck. If we see >2% end-to-end latency impact, stop rollout. Thanks everyone.

end of thread
